title.en: Add immutable course Supervisors and My Students
title.zh: 新增不可改绑的课程 Supervisor 与我的学生

purpose.en: Let a learner assign one eligible VIP or administrator RefID to a course subscription, preserve that attribution through shared links and checkout, and give eligible Supervisors a private language-filtered student view.
purpose.zh: 允许学员为课程订阅绑定一名符合资格的 VIP 或管理员 RefID，在分享链接与结账链路中保留归属，并为符合资格的 Supervisor 提供按语言筛选的私有学生视图。

en: Show an optional Supervisor RefID on each signed-in learner's subscribed course card and validate the RefID against active VIP or administrator eligibility.
Add a localized My Students account destination for eligible VIP members and administrators, with learning-language filtering, learner, course, status, expiry, and reward eligibility.
Give eligible Supervisors a shareable course URL whose immutable attribution survives sign-in, card checkout, Stripe reconciliation, Polygon USDT, and GLC reconciliation.
Auto-assign an eligible VIP or administrator actor when that actor manually enables a learner's built-in course subscription.
zh: 在登录学员的已订阅课程卡片显示可选 Supervisor RefID，并按有效 VIP 或管理员资格验证该 RefID。
为符合资格的 VIP 与管理员新增多语言“我的学生”账户入口，可按学习语言筛选并查看学员、课程、状态、到期时间与奖励资格。
为符合资格的 Supervisor 提供课程分享链接；不可改绑的归属可跨登录、信用卡结账、Stripe 对账、Polygon USDT 与 GLC 对账保留。
符合资格的 VIP 或管理员手动启用学员内置课程订阅时，自动将操作者设为 Supervisor。

en: My Courses, course details, account menu, My Students, card checkout and webhook reconciliation, SmartPay3 checkout and claim reconciliation, administrator student controls, D1 subscriptions, and release reporting.
zh: 我的课程、课程详情、账户菜单、我的学生、信用卡结账与回调核对、SmartPay3 结账与领取核对、管理员学生控制、D1 订阅及发布报告。

en: Add Supervisor user and RefID columns, database-level self-assignment and reassignment guards, indexed private lookups, and an independent purchase-scoped VIP reward-eligibility ledger.
Preserve the first valid Supervisor with conflict-safe subscription writes; reject unknown, ineligible, or self-owned RefIDs before checkout and again when payment is recorded.
Reverse a Supervisor reward-eligibility event when the related Stripe purchase is refunded or disputed without changing the learner's immutable attribution history.
Keep Supervisor rewards separate from the existing direct-introducer points ledger, whose published platform-subscription-only boundary is unchanged.
zh: 新增 Supervisor 用户与 RefID 字段、数据库级自我绑定和改绑保护、私有查询索引，以及独立且按购买记录限定的 VIP 奖励资格账本。
通过冲突安全的订阅写入保留首个有效 Supervisor；结账前与付款入账时都拒绝未知、无资格或属于学员自己的 RefID。
Stripe 课程购买发生退款或争议时冲正相应 Supervisor 奖励资格事件，但不改写学员不可变的归属历史。
Supervisor 奖励与现有直接介绍人积分账本保持独立；后者只适用于平台订阅付款的公开边界不变。

en: Passed the verified production build, strict TypeScript, zero-warning lint, all 404 site tests, SmartPay3 contract tests, 69-migration replay and idempotency, foreign-key validation, sensitive-data scanning, and authored-diff checks.

Migration 0174_course_subscription_supervisor.sql is additive; runtime tests prove that one valid Supervisor is accepted while reassignment and self-supervision are rejected by D1-compatible SQLite constraints.
zh: 已通过经验证的生产构建、严格 TypeScript、零警告 lint、全部 404 项站点测试、SmartPay3 合约测试、69 个迁移的重放与幂等检查、外键检查、敏感数据扫描及作者改动格式检查。
0174_course_subscription_supervisor.sql 为增量迁移；运行时测试证明首个有效 Supervisor 可写入，而改绑和自我监督会被 D1 兼容的 SQLite 约束拒绝。

en: The release records purchase price as the reward basis and an auditable eligibility state, but does not invent a payout amount or rate; an administrator-published VIP reward rule is required before an eligible event can become earned or payable.
zh: 本次发布记录购买价格作为奖励基数及可审计的资格状态，但不会擅自设定奖励金额或比例；资格事件转为已赚取或可支付之前，需要管理员发布 VIP 奖励规则。

en: Keep SmartLingo's twelve interface and learning languages, platform-built course model, Clerk identity, D1 data, Stripe, SmartPay3, wallets, and GitHub Actions to Cloudflare deployment isolated from every other site.
zh: 继续保持 SmartLingo 的十二种界面与学习语言、平台内置课程模型、Clerk 身份、D1 数据、Stripe、SmartPay3、钱包及 GitHub Actions 到 Cloudflare 发布流程与其他站点完全隔离。

rollback.en: Roll back application code to the prior Worker release while leaving additive Supervisor columns, indexes, triggers, and audit events intact; destructive database rollback requires a separately reviewed retention decision.
rollback.zh: 应用代码可回滚到上一 Worker 版本，同时保留增量 Supervisor 字段、索引、触发器与审计事件；破坏性数据库回滚需要另行审查数据保留决定。
